info.name: Recommendations API 🔮🔮🔮
info.description:
- Endpoint: `GET /rec1/api.{json|xml}` - related technology recommendations for a domain.
- Example: `https://api.builtwith.com/rec1/api.json?KEY=YOUR_KEY&LOOKUP=example.com`
- Credits: 1 per lookup.

Sample response (`https://api.builtwith.com/samples/recommendations_api_v1.json`):
```json
[
  {
    "Domain": "example.com",
    "Recommendations": [
      {
        "name": "Zendesk",
        "tag": "mx",
        "categories": [],
        "stars": 4,
        "match": 0.126
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

Updated 2026-11-10 from https://api.builtwith.com/llms-full.txt. Set KEY locally. Requests are examples; sending data requests may consume credits. Optional query parameters are disabled until selected.

query.description: The root domain you'd like to do a lookup for. This can be CSV of up to 16 root domains max.

request.description: Gets the technologies recommended for web domains based on cross over.
